changes: Added a host-neutral read-only playbook_promotion_observe CLI command and smoke coverage to observe candidate generation, explicit candidate consumption, and promotion recommendation handling without mutating learning state.
usage: Run lattice playbook_promotion_observe --since=14d --json to inspect current candidates, candidate outcome consumption, and handled or unhandled promotion recommendations from the local Proofbound learning store.
expectedOutcome: The command reports whether real candidate playbooks exist, whether candidate outcomes came from explicit exposure and structured verdict sources, and whether actionable promotion recommendations have been handled or remain pending.
actualTranscript: Build passed, playbook-promotion-observe smoke passed 11/11 checks, lattice playbook_promotion_observe --since=14d --json returned a non_authoritative read-only report with zero current candidates, zero consumed candidates, and zero actionable recommendations in this local store window.
outcomeDiff: Expected a read-only observation report; actual output matched and showed no current local candidate or recommendation backlog, so M7/M8 automation is not yet justified by local backlog evidence.
limitations: The command observes existing local learning records only. It does not generate candidates, consume candidates, activate playbooks, or provide DONE gate evidence.
pitfalls: Do not treat DONE success as candidate helped. Candidate consumption requires explicit exposureMode and structured verdictSource, and candidate recommendations remain advisory until a separate activation or rejection action handles them.
